svg.title: Battery power board: 1:4 connection layout
svg.desc: 48 by 16 inch proposed board, shown at 1:4. Bus bars are6.5 by1.34 inches, ANLholders4.8 by1.45, ClassT7 by2. Bodies are to listed scale; connection dots and cable paths are approximate.
svg.text: Power board: scaled bodies and connection lines
1:4 body outlines on the proposed 48 x 16 in board. Top view; front at bottom. All positions are proposed.
Body sizes: supplied product drawings. Terminal dots: illustrative centers. Cable lines: connection routes, with bends and lengths unverified.
BULVACK has a reserved area because its body size is unknown. Covers, lugs, cable diameters and tool access need a dry fit.
FRONT EDGE / BATTERY LEADS DESCEND TO PACKS BELOW
6 bus bars: 6.50 x 1.34 in. Listed cover height 2.09 in.
7 ANL holders: 4.80 x 1.45 in. Listed height 1.47 in.
Class T holder: 7.00 x 2.00 in. Published height 2.30 in.
White gaps at crossings represent separate insulated wires.
Only labelled studs and fuse terminals are connection points.
The 3.15 in ANL value is overall fuse length, not stud spacing.
Battery fuse source stubs need actual short routes to each pack.
Equal battery cable construction and current sharing need review.
* Fuse values remain proposals; the supplied ANL image shows a 60 A kit.
Product dimensions do not establish electrical approval or bend clearance.
12 OCT 2026 | REV A | PRELIMINARY | SHEET 2 OF 3
